## Introduction

This report investigates factors associated with employee ratings of their
workplace. I will estimate and compare competing linear regression models,
evaluate model diagnostics, and interpret the results of a preferred model.

## Data
```{r}
#| label: load-data

data("attitude", package = "datasets")

analysis_data <- attitude |>
  dplyr::select(rating, complaints, learning, raises)
```
The analysis uses the built-in R dataset `attitude`. The analysis dataset
has 30 departments and four variables: overall workplace rating
(`rating`), handling of employee complaints (`complaints`), opportunity
to learn (`learning`), and raises based on performance (`raises`).
The scores represent department-level percentages of favourable employee
responses. So, each observation represents a department instead of an individual employee.
